events.title: Flash Flood near I Kihei
events.description: 1 death. Maui County. Flash flooding closed Pulehu Road was above the landfill, South Kihei Road near Kulanihakoi Gulch, and Piilani Highway near Nuu. A firefighter helping to clear flood waters was swept into a storm drain and carried about 800 yards to the ocean at around 1 pm HST. He succumbed to injuries on February 4, 2023.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Waihee
events.description: 2 deaths (indirect). Maui County. Two hikers went missing along the Waikamoi Trail in East Maui. As of this writing, the body of one hiker had been found, apparently swept out to sea over a waterfall in the area. The other hiker remained unaccounted for, but he likely perished as well.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Kahakuloa
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Maui County. A 26-year-old woman died when she was swept out to sea after the place where she was swimming near Hana became swollen by rainwater that had fallen over the upper slopes of Haleakala.

events.title: Flash Flood near Princeville
events.description: 1 death. Kauai County. Flooding waters on Kuhio Highway closed the roadway near the Hanalei Bridge in the northern part of Kauai. One fatality occurred when a man jumped into the swollen Waikomo Stream to try to save a dog.

events.title: Flash Flood near Honokaa
events.description: 1 death. Hawaii County. Flooding rain damaged a store in the Hamakua District on the Big Island of Hawaii, in the town of Honokaa. Also, a man died in leeward Big Island in the later evening on the 18th. His was staying in a shack-like structure on a coffee farm in Holualoa when, apparently, strong and gusty winds from a thunderstorm blew the structure about 150 feet from its foundation; and he was killed.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Holualoa
events.description: 1 death. Hawaii County. A shack-like structure was blown 150 feet off its foundation by the thunderstorm winds. Time of event estimated based on radar.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Ookala
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Hawaii County. Man and woman were swept away by rising waters from precipitation at Piihonua Falls near the Wailuku River. The man was able to make it to the riverbank, but the woman could not be located and was presumed drowned.

events.title: Flash Flood near Honokaa
events.description: 1 death. Hawaii County. A woman attempted to cross fast-moving water that was knee-deep in a private driveway off Kahana Drive in Ahumoa near Honokaa on the Big Island of Hawaii. She was swept away and was found dead the next morning, Jan. 22.

events.title: Flash Flood near Wailua
events.description: 1 death. Kauai County. Flash flooding at a stream near the Wailua River on Kauai swept a woman away to her death, though others in the kayak and hiking tour group managed to get to safety.

events.title: Flash Flood near Hilo
events.description: 1 death. Hawaii County.
